description: Add a trap to filled paths: a stroke in the same color as the fill, set to overprint, so a press misregistration does not leave a white gap along the edge. Illustrator has no trapping API; this is the manual prepress technique, applied for you. Only paths with a solid fill are trapped — gradients and patterns are skipped (there is no single color to stroke with), as are locked objects; both are listed in skipped. strokeOverprint is read back after writing, and objects where it did not stick are listed in failed. Ask your printer for the trap width before using this: 0.25–0.5 pt is common for offset, but it depends on the press and the stock.

round.description: Use round caps and joins so the trap follows corners without spikes

target.description: Used when uuids is omitted: "selection" (selected objects) or "all" (every top-level object in the document)

uuids.description: UUIDs of objects to trap. Groups and compound paths are walked down to the paths inside. Omit to use target.

weight.description: Trap width in points. 0.25–0.5 pt is common for offset printing; confirm with your printer.

name: make_trap_stroke
